name: VESPER AESTHETICS Stellarform Chromaveil Eye
description:
The Stellarform Chromaveil is Vesper Aesthetics' flagship fashion ocular, replacing the natural iris and sclera with a programmable bioluminescent display surface while preserving the organic lens for natural vision. The iris layer cycles through user-defined chromatic patterns—from slow aurora gradients to rapid prismatic strobing—while the sclera can be set to a deep bioluminescent glow in 24 selectable base tones. A companion app manages pattern libraries, scheduled displays, and social-sync mode that mirrors a partner's eye patterns in real time.

The Stellarform is the definitive status eye for Meridian's Tier 4–5 social circuit, seen on every major Spire influencer and most celebrity entertainers working the Canopy district clubs. Vesper sells them in curated seasonal colorways with names like Abyssal Violet and Solstice Ember, and the resale market for discontinued palettes runs nearly as hot as the primary market.
installation_requirements: Licensed cosmetic ocular technician; 2-hour outpatient procedure; no general anesthesia required
rejection_risk: Low — biocompatible scleral and iris housing designed for minimal immune response; rare allergic reaction to bioluminescent substrate
maintenance: Bioluminescent substrate recharge via clinic visit every 18 months; app firmware auto-updates via Vesper cloud

side_effects: Mild photosensitivity in high-glow mode under direct sunlight
Social sync mode occasionally causes involuntary pattern mirroring with nearby non-paired Vesper units
Rare cases of bioluminescent substrate hypersensitivity causing persistent scleral redness
App dependency — loss of device access locks eye patterns to last active setting indefinitely
cultural_context: Stellarforms are the ocular equivalent of a designer handbag in Meridian's Spire social economy—visible, aspirational, and ruthlessly trend-sensitive. Knockoff versions using inferior bioluminescent substrates circulate in Tier 2–3 markets under names like Fakegazers, and the visual difference between genuine and counterfeit is a social skill the Canopy elite cultivate deliberately.
known_users: High-end sex workers and companion professionals
Ambitious Tier 3 aspirants saving for the status upgrade
Fashion journalists and influencer-class content creators
story_hooks: A socialite's Stellarforms are displaying a pattern no one programmed—it's transmitting encrypted data to an unknown receiver buried in the Vesper cloud
A discontinued seasonal colorway called Obsidian Requiem is being sold on the black market at extortionate prices; the original run was supposedly destroyed—someone knows why
The Vesper Atelier app's latest update quietly enabled passive facial scanning, and someone is harvesting that data from every Stellarform in the city
